methodology.hypothesis: A sector-focused equity sleeve may not capture deterioration across the wider equity market. Test a signal-only breadth gate from all nine original, already audited sector funds, rather than retune the failed Treasury routes or the equity composition.
methodology.breadth: At an original completed source month end, count funds whose actual adjusted close is strictly above their own trailing 200-observation mean including that close. Equality is off. Strong breadth requires a strict majority of all nine (at least five), not a fitted percentage. No ranking, weighting, sector removal, price substitution or daily trigger.
methodology.risk: Keep the original half-SOXX/equal-four-style equity composition and monthly63-session equity/gold risk balance with30%-70%source equity bounds. Strong breadth leaves all original targets unchanged; weak breadth applies the existing half or zero scale only to the entire equity component. Gold stays exact and all removed equity budget goes only to actual BIL. No minimum equity reimposed, Treasury routing, dollar/option confirmation, volatility cap or wealth floor.
methodology.warmup: Retain all2805original price dates and every formal return session. No target is emitted before all nine200-observation means are available. Thereafter only original source month ends issue targets; each formal window uses its own complete last-known target seed.
methodology.source: Reuse the frozen actual nine-fund issuer/PDF/raw/CSV source through its existing versioned price-only adapter. Signals do not add tradable assets to the original12-asset portfolio. This is fixed-fund ETF trend breadth, not constituent/PIT-stock breadth or the full evolving eleven-sector classification; historical mandate/constituent limits remain.
methodology.source_versions: Before preparation, shared-source inspection found separately frozen XLK adjusted-price versions: maximum open/close differences3.85e-5/3.81e-5,raw close4.85e-10,volume0. Keep the initially specified original sector snapshot for every signal, never replace original portfolio prices; XLK has exactly zero original portfolio targets. Eight shared core assets retain the original strict identity check. No tolerance relaxation, unknown mismatch allowance, source choice from returns or new quote request.
methodology.prior_art: The200-observation strict sector trend and all nine funds come from the original factor-research policy. Half and zero scales already exist. Aggregating their price trends by structural strict majority is a new risk-construction hypothesis, not an independent economic factor discovery or replication of old four-style63/126/252relative-return breadth.
